translation: He titled it 《Miyao》 (Arcane Essentials), meaning the essential. Since the Song emperor's edict to publish it, no one has again carved it to broaden its transmission. Is this not because those who follow the current fashion and seek the source and verify the root are few among their kind! What affair in the world should not take the ancients as teacher? In writing, beyond the Six Classics one must pursue Qin and Han; in calligraphy, after the seal script one must model on Zhong and Wang. Is it not so to the utmost? Formerly Zu Ne said: In distinguishing and explaining the classics, small differences and similarities are not enough to harm the moral influence; but if the decoctions and medicines are slightly not understood, then later people... This is my deep intention in urgently wishing to make the 《Waitai Miyao》 public within the seas. Previously I purchased a manuscript copy, which had quite many errors and omissions, so I again exhausted my strength to collate it.
